# QUESTIONS — inline-lane

1. **Shape.** Options: (a) RECOMMENDED tabs inside `s` on the arrows; (b) a
   top-level key of its own; (c) a toggle inside the current view.

2. **Which clock an age is measured against.** Options: (a) the host's wall
   clock, transitively; (b) a mesh median; (c) true UTC via a time server.
   Recommendation: (a) — it is the only one that needs no network.
